method: Read-only source, test and existing receipt inspection. No browser, replay, test, production/script edit or Git mutation was performed for this audit.

conclusion.assessment: Implemented fairness, recovery, ownership and persistence contracts have focused regression and browser evidence. The currently running actual two-hour rotation and the recorded human/device gates remain separate acceptance items. Lifecycle limitations below must not be presented as completed browser checks.

invariants.finding: Modes are visited before repetition; each mode selects unvisited level/variant keys before recordings. Duplicate recordings do not increase level weight. Failed entries defer their mode for the current attempt cycle; unavailable engines are session-suspended. Healthy unvisited modes precede a verified recovery fallback.
invariants.limit: Normal cycles avoid adjacent mode/level repeats when alternatives exist. Explicit bounded recovery may repeat the last verified performance; it is not evidence of ordinary rotation unfairness.

invariants.finding: Per-source deadlines and the 30-second overall budget include elapsed preparation and retirement, with host enumeration time deducted. Late completion cannot adopt a superseded player. Failed preparation and late returned owners get cleanup attempts. A pending retirement blocks replacement; Retry/Back remain the recovery path.
invariants.limit: A synchronous browser task cannot be preempted by a JavaScript timer; elapsed-time checks reject overdue results when control returns. The offline probe demonstrates bounded failure/recovery, not playback of every entry from every offline cache.

invariants.finding: Spectator playback uses the shared clock. Practice stops that clock and advances through the shared host from the originating page frame. Native scene paint reads player/practice state and does not advance gameplay. Native timesteps remain engine-owned.
invariants.limit: The ordinary paused renderer may remain mounted. The invariant is one active demo simulation/scene, not one canvas or one renderer object in the entire page.

invariants.finding: Hidden watching admits at most two seconds of debt in quarter-second slices, with bounded catch-up tasks and no hidden painting. Freeze cancels scheduling and resume rebases time. Foreground loss clears input and suspends practice/handoffs. Watching preserves explicit pause and listening intent.
limits: The real Chromium CDP freeze/resume check covers playing and explicitly paused watching. Firefox/WebKit mixed checks omit this Chromium-only protocol branch.
Hidden/blur/restore semantics also have mounted controlled-clock tests; those are not physical mobile operating-system lifecycle observations.

No explicit actual-browser discard/reload or back-forward-cache round-trip receipt was found in the inspected current mixed/indexed evidence. Ordinary reload follows normal entry because demo playback/practice is not persisted; this is source-based reasoning, not a completed discard browser test.

invariants.finding: Close cancels admission immediately; the retirement barrier survives close/reopen and resolves to undefined instead of retaining recursive result history. Every owned cleanup is attempted independently. Solo preserves asynchronous release promises and re-releases late assets once. Transient Phaser lifecycle hooks have explicit ownership and preserve the originating game.
invariants.observed: After warming all four modes, 12 mixed Next transitions across three open/close cycles returned 79 attached targets to the listener baseline (window 161; document 78), with zero listener-signature deltas, zero owned scenes/practice/actual workers at close, preserved canvas ownership and ordinary dimensions, unchanged storage and exact paused ordinary checkpoint.
limits: The direct listener probe measures attached targets and direct event-listener signatures/counts; it does not exhaustively measure detached nodes, heap closures, native driver allocations or all GPU memory.
No forced garbage collection or heap dump was performed. Coarse process RSS without an initial baseline cannot prove or disprove a leak.
The Phaser source-contract regression intentionally requires review if the pinned dependency lifecycle changes.

invariants.finding: Watching and reconstructed practice use isolated native state; late forks are disposed. Generic controls normalize captured raw samples without another hardware poll; native SIM retains raw radio/throttle handling. Ordinary Fresh uses existing departure/adoption guards and enters Ready, with exact demonstrated SIM/Survival setup. Only explicit preference/audio actions write their own settings.
invariants.limit: Synthetic controller/radio events verify ownership logic, not physical device calibration, drift characteristics, throttle feel or real mobile input.

fullNativeCoverage.limit: Native full replays, terminal outcomes, current content identities and meaningful progress; not 890 complete rendered interactive UI sessions.

fullBrowserNativeReplay.counting: Solo has 242 distinct clips for 240 required levels; browser-specific alternatives do not add levels or selection weight.
fullBrowserNativeReplay.provenance: These receipts retain their actual historical browser/source bases. The 461ace impact audit and integrated checks cover unchanged native/content inputs and changed ordinary entry behavior; they are not relabeled as newly executed full-corpus browser runs.

exactTick.scope: Four representative performances, one per mode, in each of Chromium/Firefox/WebKit; strict trace capture/comparison, injected mismatches, reference rejection and cancellation.
exactTick.limit: Not an all-890-entry per-tick browser trace matrix. Runtime sparse checkpoints identify the first mismatching checkpoint; exact offline traces identify the first differing native tick.

regressions.limit: Related/overlapping suites must not be added together. This audit did not rerun them.

currentEndurance.limit: Requires 7200 measured seconds after preflight and final close/storage/resource/source checks. Earlier partial runs and accelerated clock tests contribute no elapsed acceptance time.
